claim: Let A=(a_n) and B=(b_n) be increasing bi-infinite real sequences with \(0<\delta_A\le a_{n+1}-a_n\le\alpha\), \(0<\delta_B\le b_{n+1}-b_n\le\beta\), and \(\alpha\beta<1\). For the unitary transform \(\widehat f(\xi)=2^{-1/2}\int_{\mathbb R}f(t)e^{-\pi i t\xi}\,dt\), let \(\mathcal H_0=\{\psi\in L^2(\mathbb R):\widehat\psi\in C_0(\mathbb R)\}\), \(\varphi(t)=t^{-2}\psi(1/t)\), \(R_A=(\sum_n|\widehat\psi(a_n)|^2)^{1/2}\), and \(R_B=(\sum_n|\widehat\varphi(b_n)|^2)^{1/2}\), with the reciprocal transform understood distributionally as in the \(\mathcal H_0\) framework. If \(\psi\in\mathcal H_0\) and \(R_A,R_B<\infty\), define \(C_A=\sqrt\alpha+2\alpha/(\pi\sqrt{\delta_A})\) and \(C_B=\sqrt\beta+2\beta/(\pi\sqrt{\delta_B})\). Then \(t\psi\in L^2(\mathbb R)\) and \(\|\psi\|_2\le(C_A R_A+\alpha C_B R_B)/(1-\alpha\beta)\), \(\|t\psi\|_2\le(\beta C_A R_A+C_B R_B)/(1-\alpha\beta)\).
scientific_integrity: Self-contained analytic proof from a piecewise-linear interpolation lemma, Poincare-Wirtinger, Plancherel, and reciprocal-change-of-variables identities. No finite experiment is used as proof; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The estimate is proved only for increasing bi-infinite sequences with positive lower gap bounds, finite upper gap bounds, square-summable residuals, and alpha beta strictly below one.
The explicit constants are not claimed to be optimal; no critical or supercritical stability estimate is established.
title: A residual stability bound for hyperbola-supported Fourier uniqueness
